title: Stylized Character: Character Creator, Marvelous Designer and Blender Workflow
content:
### ![fc393d7faa274eb9b1c3db6b8b89df53](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/013a7ea375ef416daf1a7cc8eed706ed/images/fc393d7faa274eb9b1c3db6b8b89df53still4.jpg)**Melis Caner / Melniverse**

Hi, I’m Melis Caner, a 3D Generalist and filmmaker. My lifelong love for drawing, fashion, dancing, and acting now comes together in 3D animation, blending all my passions into one art form.  
<https://www.instagram.com/melniverse/>

* * *

Lately, I’ve been obsessed with Jackson Wang- Cruel music video. I really like where the Dancer Queen character moves the boulders from the ground. So I wanted to create a similar scene, but in my style. Time: 2:00

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rhy7_Y15FrI?si=wO4yRN21uU4x6ela?start=120

To start with the character I want to dress I used Character Creator 5. I start by using the new HD Stylized base model. It's easy to use and totally customizable. ![38eca3fc32434402b16e53274500124f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/013a7ea375ef416daf1a7cc8eed706ed/images/38eca3fc32434402b16e53274500124fmel-05-1536x864.webp)  
I captured my motion with the Rokoko motion capture suit. 

I added facial animation with the Digital Soul pack in iClone. This basically drags and drops the selected expression, then applies it to my character.  
![c6c1d9b76ca7442786a37beacc5e78fc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/013a7ea375ef416daf1a7cc8eed706ed/images/c6c1d9b76ca7442786a37beacc5e78fcmel-06-2-1536x864.webp)  
**3D Cloth Customization and Cloth Simulation**

For the outfit, I downloaded a 3D suit on CLO Connect, uploaded by MONA.   
<https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/350811/info>  
On top of it, I designed the cropped sleeves of the clothing, and then simulated everything in Marvelous Designer.  
![1f14ce0b5573425a82264856890e5e4a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/013a7ea375ef416daf1a7cc8eed706ed/images/1f14ce0b5573425a82264856890e5e4amel-09-1536x898.webp)

Finally, I built the scene in Blender using the 3D Scans that scanned by Blendreams in the ancient city in Turkey. <https://www.instagram.com/blendreams/>  
![c24cee7ab4584524b824e8c6a69f3c61](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/013a7ea375ef416daf1a7cc8eed706ed/images/c24cee7ab4584524b824e8c6a69f3c61mel-10-1536x907.webp)![4b1904f865974d2ebe8db0e4e8fc2afb](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/013a7ea375ef416daf1a7cc8eed706ed/images/4b1904f865974d2ebe8db0e4e8fc2afbmel-12.jpg)  
You can see the full breakdown video and the final result here:

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HzqBfl-cvPY?si=frV-CjrfPZxc_fAz

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Comment 2: Wow I’m following you on the instagram❤️ so good to see you here😍
Reply 1: Thank you ❤️ happy to connect!
content_description: Showcasing Melis Caner’s creative process and techniques in 3D animation and character design inspired by Jackson Wang’s "Cruel" music video.

title: Casualwear Collection | 3D Apparel Presentation
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/4384c7768e734ac2b1fb16b1f418143e/images/835610bf981c4b20b80a2b0e0b0dc0f4digital_apparel_BC.jpg)![93e463767fbb47779f59f99199cf3aa8](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202603/4384c7768e734ac2b1fb16b1f418143e/images/93e463767fbb47779f59f99199cf3aa8digital_apparel_BC.jpg)  
Hello CLO community!!

I’d like to share **digital apparel showcase developed using 3D garment design tools**. The collection includes various casualwear pieces such as **hoodies, striped polo's, sweatshirts & activewear**, all created entirely in a 3D environment.

As many of you already experience, **3D apparel design is transforming the fashion development process**. Brands today need faster product cycles, clearer visualization, and fewer physical samples. With accurate digital garments, teams can review designs, adjust fit, and finalize styles much earlier in the development stage.

### Why 3D Apparel Development Is Important Today  
✔ Reduced physical sampling and development cost  
✔ Faster product approvals and decision making  
✔ Better communication between design, merchandising & production  
✔ Creation of assets for marketing, e-commerce, and digital showrooms

These garments were developed as part of ongoing **3D apparel exploration and workflow practice** , focusing on realistic materials, garment construction and digital presentation.

I’d love to hear feedback from the community and also learn how others are integrating **3D workflows into their apparel development process**.

Always happy to connect with fellow **CLO designers, 3D artists, and digital fashion creators** here.

Thank you!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: 👍🏻
content_description: Showcasing innovative 3D-designed casual apparel to highlight how digital garment development accelerates fashion workflows and enhances collaboration within the CLO community.
